manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through zero velocity at its peak with a ball dropped from rest at the same height. At the peak, velocity is instant zero while downward gravitational acceleration remains constant.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. At the top of the toss, a gate releases the second ball from rest. Both balls then accelerate downward together.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
